item.name: Determine what messages are in the e-Hub queue

request.name: Determine what messages are in the e-Hub queue

description.content: Returns meta-data of messages in e-Hub queue for the participant initiating the API request.

query.description: (Required) ParticipantID of the Participant invoking the API

response.name: aseXML message listing the messages & its meta data in the e-Hub queue.
This response is provided when the submitted payload cannot be passed successfully.
This response is provided when the resource name missing from URL or is invalid.
This response is provided when the method is not POST
This response is provided when the throttling limits are reached.
This response is provided when any unforeseen error is encountered, such as; Certificate/key do not match or incorrect or e-Hub/API/downstream service is not available or Malformed payload.

header.description: (Required) Message ID defined by the Participant. The messageContextID is used in the following ways: 1. To provide a contextID for the message exchange. The participant/e-Hub uses the contextID of the original request when delivering its corresponding MACK(s). 2. If the Recipient is on FTP, the filename is set to .zip. 3. The name of the archive files is set to .zip. 4. To provide context to the failure messages to be returned where the incoming payload is unreadable such as, the payload is schema invalid. Format of is: [TransactionGroup 0-9_a-z]{1,4} + [Priority h|m|l] + "_" + [FromParticipantID]{1,10} + "_" + [0-9_a-z]{1,18}

description.content: Purpose - Acknowledge a received message. Detail - For every message, a message acknowledgment is generated (with the exception of messages containing message acknowledgements). A BusinessReceipt has two possible implementations - • MessageAcknowledgement. • Event, errors are reported via Event elements. If a message is rejected, no receipt identifier is required with the acknowledgement. This resource will be used when Participants are required to send Message Acknowledgement in the HTTP request. messageContextID should be set to the messageContextID of the original message that is to be acknowledged. In order that the sender receive timely acknowledgement of message delivery, the receiver should respond immediately to each aseXML message with a message acknowledgement. Note: If a Participant is required to send a transaction message or transaction acknowledgement message, ‘/messages’ resource is to be used. If a Participant is required to send ‘message acknowledgements’ in the request payload, then ‘/messageAcknowledgements’ resource is to be used.
